faceSwap.title: Face Swap
faceSwap.setupIntro: Face swap needs a processing tool downloaded to your machine. Click below to install it automatically (a few GB on first use).
faceSwap.installNote: First run downloads the tool + models (~3-5GB). Later runs start instantly. Requires git to be installed.
faceSwap.advanced: Advanced: use a FaceFusion install already on your machine
faceSwap.pythonPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the .venv inside the directory
faceSwap.enhance: Smooth & sharpen the face after swapping
faceSwap.enhanceHint: Makes the swapped face clearer and more natural, but takes longer.
faceSwap.providerHint: Leave on "Auto" — the app uses your GPU for speed. GPU is about 8x faster than CPU.
faceSwap.done: Face swap finished — added to library
faceSwap.doneReplaced: Face swap finished — replaced the video on the timeline
faceSwap.resultHint: Pick a library video already on the timeline and the result replaces it automatically. Pick an external file and it appears in the Media tab to drag in.
faceSwap.consentNote: Only use images you have the rights to and with the consent of the people involved.
faceSwap.cpuWarning: ⚠ No GPU acceleration on this machine — swaps will be very slow (a few-minute video can take hours). Prefer short clips.
